zoe-cs: Heads-up — during onboarding ramp we saw a surge of 401s followed by rapid 429s from our embedding calls. It always starts right after a deploy/cold start. Anyone seen this with serverless setups?

trent-eng: Yep, this pattern is classic: lots of parallel cold starts + aggressive token refresh or bad preflight behavior. Can you paste the init code and a few log lines?

zoe-cs: Init: ```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY, keepAlive: true, batchSize: 500 });
await client.embeddings.create({ input: docs });
```
Logs: "embed failed 401 unauthorized" then immediate "429 embed_units exceeded" spikes.

maria-support: Two quick checks: 1) are you rotating short-lived keys on a tight cadence? 2) do you have a proxy that might be rewriting auth headers? Both can cause a 401 wave then a retry storm.

zoe-cs: We rotate tokens from our auth service every 45s. Each function instance fetches a token on cold start. We also have an internal edge proxy that does auth_request.

trent-eng: That fits. If many instances cold start and each requests a new token then starts hitting Redwood, and if the proxy or token service introduces slight latency, those spikes align. Retries from clients then push you into 429s.

maria-support: Immediate mitigation: reduce batchSize (try 64-128), add jitter to token refresh to spread requests, and limit concurrent warmup requests from your deployment job. Also ensure your proxy forwards Authorization and doesn't cache the auth subrequest responses.

zoe-cs: Reducing batch to 128 + adding a 0-20s random splay on refresh. Also put a concurrency cap on our warmup lambda (4).

trent-eng: Another good pattern: process-local token cache with a single refresh lock per process so you don't refresh in parallel within the same container. Example: 
```js
let token=null; let expiry=0; let refreshing=false;
async function getToken(){ const now=Date.now()/1000; if(token && now < expiry-10) return token; if(refreshing){ await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100 + Math.random()*200)); return token; } refreshing=true; try{ const r = await fetch('/token'); token = await r.text(); expiry = now + 50 + Math.random()*20; return token; } finally{ refreshing=false; } }
```

maria-support: We can also temporarily increase the embed-unit allowance window for your account for the onboarding ramp. Do you want us to do that while you test?

zoe-cs: Yes please, that would help for the soak. After the changes we saw 401s drop to near zero and 429s flatten out. Looks stable so far.

deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-03-23T09:12:10Z — rollout to netlify-prod completed for zoe-team.

zoe-cs: Thanks all 44d. Can we schedule a short sync to review serverless best-practices and token lease patterns?

maria-support: Yep, we have a 30min slot Monday 11am PT. I'll record and attach a short note with the token cache pattern.

trent-eng: I'll add a tiny code sample to the note about keeping keepAlive false for cold-start-heavy nets if you can't control concurrency.

zoe-cs: Perfect — will run extended soak and report back.
